09d5f279-dfc7-4037-825e-5e2b6ebb7bae.description: Error ratio over 5m is above 14.4x the 1% error budget (fast burn); at this rate a 30-day budget lasts about 2 days.

facts.statement: The only diff between checkout revisions 1 and 2 is PAYMENT_ADDR, changed from payment:8080 to payment:9999. Revision 2 was created at 15:42:52Z.
Checkout error spans are gRPC dial i/o timeouts to 10.96.40.41:9999 on PaymentService/Charge. They propagate to PlaceOrder and to frontend 500s.
payment has had no change since 15:30:15Z and has no warning events. Its last log line is at 15:42:50Z, and it records no server-side Charge errors.
Checkout's error ratio rose to about 0.45, and its client-side Charge calls error at about 0.12 per second.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: Check the payment Service and endpoints ports. Then roll back checkout and confirm the error ratio drops.
hypotheses.statement: Payment listens only on 8080, so nothing answers on 9999. The investigators did not check this directly.

inferences.statement: The fault is a port misconfiguration in checkout, not a payment outage. Payment stopped receiving requests when checkout rolled out at 15:42:52. The timing matches, and payment has no errors of its own.

root_causes.cause: Checkout revision 2 set PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:9999, but payment serves on 8080. Charge gRPC dials time out, which fails PlaceOrder.

diagnosis.summary: checkout is failing about 35% of requests because of its own config change. Revision 2 (15:42:52Z, 'payment client moved to port 9999') changed PAYMENT_ADDR from payment:8080 to payment:9999. Since then, checkout's PaymentService/Charge calls time out dialing 10.96.40.41:9999, and PlaceOrder and frontend /api/checkout fail with them. payment is unchanged and healthy. It simply receives no traffic: its logs stop at 15:42:50 and it records no server errors. Fix: roll back checkout to revision 1, or set PAYMENT_ADDR back to payment:8080.

actions.reason: Checkout revision 2 (15:42:52Z) changed PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:9999 while payment serves on 8080. Checkout's Charge dials time out on 10.96.40.41:9999, which fails PlaceOrder and frontend /api/checkout. Reverting to revision 1 restores the correct address.

alternatives.why_not: A restart keeps the bad PAYMENT_ADDR in the pod template, so the new pods would dial 9999 and keep failing.
More replicas would still send every Charge call to the wrong port and do not address the misconfiguration.

plan.summary: Roll back checkout from revision 2 (PAYMENT_ADDR changed to payment:9999) to revision 1 (payment:8080). Checkout's Charge calls should stop timing out, and its error ratio should fall back toward baseline within a few minutes.
